_comment: A floor's lighting controller, in JSON rather than YAML — the two formats
are interchangeable, and JSON is what a building management system is more
Included because it is a COMMERCIAL device, not a household one, and
because it shows the case the format handles worst: one endpoint that
controls many fixtures. DoSync sees one device with three actions. If each
fixture must be addressed independently, write one file per fixture, or use
a code adapter that enumerates them.

turn_on.description: All fixtures on this floor to full
